How to Grow Tomatoes

Tomatoes need at least six hours of direct sunlight every day. Choose the sunniest spot in your garden.

Planting

Plant seedlings 60 centimetres apart, after the last frost. Bury the stem deeper than it was in the pot.

Water deeply twice a week rather than a little every day, so the roots grow down.

Feeding

Use a high-potassium feed once the first flowers appear. Too much nitrogen gives leaves, not fruit.

  • Tomato feed: 10 ml per 4.5 litres of water
  • Feed every 7 to 10 days
